data.name: Boulder
data.description: You summon a colossal block of stone and send it straight towards your enemy. You deal (HR + 25) earth damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

data.name: Elemental Shroud
data.description: You weave magical energy and protect the targets from the fury of the elements. Choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire or ice. Until this spell ends, each target gains Resistance to the chosen damage type.

data.name: Elemental Weapon
data.description:
You imbue a weapon with elemental energy. Choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire, or ice. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes of the chosen damage type. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action.
This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.

data.name: Flare
data.description: You channel a single ray of fire towards your foe, its temperature so high that it will pierce through most defenses. You deal (HR + 25) fire damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

data.name: Fulgur
data.description:
You weave electricity into a wave of crackling bolts. You deal (HR + 15) bolt damage to each target hit by this spell.
Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers dazed.

data.name: Glacies
data.description:
You coat your foes under a thick layer of frost. You deal (HR + 15) ice damage to each target hit by this spell.
Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers slow.

data.name: Iceberg
data.description: A pillar of ice magic envelops your foe, dropping their temperature to critical levels. You deal (HR + 25) ice damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

data.name: Ignis
data.description:
You unleash a searing barrage against your foes, conjuring flames out of thin air. You deal (HR + 15) fire damage to each target hit by this spell.
Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers shaken.

data.name: Soaring Strike
data.description:
The wind carries your strikes across the battlefield. You may perform a free attack with a melee weapon you have equipped; this attack may target creatures that cannot normally be targeted by melee attacks.
If you used a weapon belonging to the brawling, spear, or sword Category for this attack, it deals 5 extra damage.
If you hit a flying target with this attack, you may force them to land immediately.

data.name: Terra
data.description:
Spires of jagged rock erupt from the ground beneath your foes, closing around them. You deal (HR + 15) earth damage to each target hit by this spell. This spell cannot target creatures that are flying, floating, falling, or otherwise in mid-air.
Opportunity: each target hit by this spell performs one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).

data.name: Thunderbolt
data.description: You send an arrow of overcharged lightning striking at your foe. You deal (HR + 25) bolt damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

data.name: Ventus
data.description:
You summon the power of winds against your enemy. You deal (HR + 15) air damage to each target hit by this spell.
Opportunity: each flying target hit by this spell is forced to land immediately.

data.name: Vortex
data.description: You slash through your foe with high-pressure wind. You deal (HR + 25) air damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.
